name: Mailchimp Surveys
description: Mailchimp Surveys is a hosted feedback product inside Mailchimp for collecting responses from contacts and public participants. Teams use it to publish audience-linked surveys, distribute them on the web or by email, and analyze question and respondent reports.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Mailchimp account through Relay-owned OAuth, bind the metadata-derived data center and exact account, and let agents read survey catalog and aggregate reports or approval-gate detailed respondent data and publish/distribution changes. The connector implements only the 12 pinned official survey endpoints; survey authoring and broader Mailchimp APIs remain unavailable.

capabilities.label: Survey catalog
capabilities.description: Read surveys attached to a known audience.

capabilities.label: Aggregate reports
capabilities.description: Read survey and question-level aggregate reporting.

capabilities.label: Answers and responses
capabilities.description: Read bounded detailed respondent answers and responses.

capabilities.label: Publish and distribute
capabilities.description: Publish or unpublish a survey and create a linked email campaign.

allowed.label: Read surveys
allowed.description: Read one survey or one fixed page of surveys for an audience.

allowed.label: Read aggregate survey reports
allowed.description: Read bounded survey and question-level aggregate reports.

approvalRequired.label: Read survey answers and responses
approvalRequired.description: Detailed respondent answers and responses require approval in Safe mode.

approvalRequired.label: Publish or distribute a survey
approvalRequired.description: Publishing, unpublishing, or creating an email campaign requires approval in Safe mode.

blocked.label: Author surveys
blocked.description: The official Marketing API does not expose survey creation or question editing; those remain Mailchimp UI operations.

blocked.label: Use broader Mailchimp APIs
blocked.description: Contacts, campaigns beyond survey campaign creation, commerce, exports, batches, arbitrary paths, and non-survey APIs are outside this connector.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Survey catalog and aggregate reports run directly; detailed response data and mutations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All selected pinned survey operations run without Relay per-action approval while OAuth authority, exact account/data-center binding, response bounds, audit, redaction, and the authoring/broader-API blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts the pinned survey tools and attaches the encrypted, account-bound OAuth token server-side.
Railway mounts the pinned survey tools and attaches the encrypted, account-bound OAuth token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Mailchimp requires Relay to register an OAuth application with the exact Railway callback and configure its client credentials; this worker may not perform provider-console or Railway setup.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register the exact Mailchimp Surveys Railway callback, configure staging client credentials, and run the documented staging acceptance matrix.

evidence.supports: Hosted surveys are audience-linked Mailchimp products for public or contact feedback; authoring is performed in the Mailchimp UI.
The Marketing API exposes survey list and detail plus publish, unpublish, and create-email actions for an audience.
The official API exposes overall hosted-survey reports.
The official API exposes question-level reports and answer collections.
The official API exposes response lists and individual detailed survey responses.
Mailchimp integrations use authorization-code OAuth, metadata-derived data-center routing, and non-expiring provider tokens without refresh tokens.
